spans.text: ...Where I belong...
She mutters these words tentatively, the concept solidifying for the first time in her mind.
...If there's nothing special about me... If I'm really not Lunasia... Then what meaning is there to my existence?
...Your existence doesn't need to have meaning.
But your existence is needed for things to have meaning... You are here. We are here.
She absorbs these words in silence.
The confusion and bewilderment in her eyes are slowly replaced by clarity that follows an epiphany, as well as... weariness from having shed a heavy burden.
...I see now.
I'm neither his "sister"... nor "Lunasia".
I hear you... These are... our voices.
Dandelion gazes at her quietly. The chorus of countless consciousnesses is now a gentle lull.
You have your sense of self.
Sadly, you haven't got the time to learn how to say "I".
But that's alright.
Leave that to us.
From today onward, your "I" is a part of "us".
A blue butterfly lands on her forehead, like a soft seal proving that she belongs.
...Goodnight.
The light contracts in an instant, like an Epiphyllum blooming with no warning.
The white haze retracts silently into the mechanical crevices. The collapsed white Nytos return to their original positions like receding sea foam.
As if all her strength has been sucked away, "Tokarev's" head droops and her eyes close as she falls to a short slumber.
"She" smiles a wistful, weary smile—a victor who does not relish in her victory.
And... thank you.
